core_settings.name: core_attributes.sensor_id
core_settings.label: Managing sensor
core_settings.description: Sensor that runs the integration against the FortiGate.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.host
config_settings.label: FortiGate host (FQDN or IP)
config_settings.description: Management address of the FortiGate, without scheme or port (e.g. fortigate.example.com).

config_settings.name: config_attributes.port
config_settings.label: FortiGate HTTPS admin / REST API port (not SSH)
config_settings.description: HTTPS administrative-access port used by the REST API, usually 443. Do not enter the SSH port here; SSH has its own field further down.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.authentication_method
config_settings.label: authentication_method
config_settings.description: How the FortiGate REST API token is supplied: typed directly into TLM, or resolved at runtime from an external Secrets Manager (PAM) connector.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.password
config_settings.label: FortiGate REST API token
config_settings.description: Token of a FortiGate REST API administrator (System > Administrators > Create New > REST API Admin) whose profile grants read-write on System (certificates), VPN and Firewall, and whose trusted hosts include the sensor.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.pam_connector_id
config_settings.label: secrets_manager_connector
config_settings.description: Registered Secrets Manager (PAM) connector that resolves the FortiGate REST API token at runtime.

conditional_banners.title: Note
conditional_banners.description: Use the format systemName slash accountName to reference the FortiGate API token from BeyondTrust vaults

conditional_banners.title: Note
conditional_banners.description: Use the object or secret name to reference the FortiGate API token from CyberArk vaults

conditional_banners.title: Note
conditional_banners.description: Use the numeric secret id optionally followed by slash field slug to reference the FortiGate API token from Delinea secrets

config_settings.name: config_attributes.password
config_settings.label: FortiGate REST API token (PAM vault reference)
config_settings.description: Enter the PAM vault reference that holds the FortiGate REST API token, not the token itself. BeyondTrust: SystemName/AccountName. CyberArk: object name. Delinea: secretId or secretId/fieldSlug.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.vdom
config_settings.label: FortiGate VDOM
config_settings.description: VDOM whose SSL-VPN / admin / IPsec / VIP objects are scanned and repointed. Default root.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.certificateScope
config_settings.label: Certificate scope
config_settings.description: Where the managed certificates live. 'global' (default) covers certificates imported through the GUI or with scope=global; 'vdom' covers certificates that belong to the VDOM above.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.keepReplacedCertificate
config_settings.label: Replaced certificate after rotation
config_settings.description: What happens to the previous certificate once every SSL-VPN / admin / IPsec / VIP reference has been repointed to the new one and FortiOS reports it as unreferenced. 'Delete' (default) removes it; 'Keep' leaves it in place for manual clean-up. Built-in certificates are never deleted.
